title: The Beast Calls
text: The thing that walked the walls has started calling at night: a long low note, like a horn blown underground, that sets the dogs bleeding from their noses. It is calling to something inside the city, and every House would like to know what.

options.label: Put a Scion on the walls to answer it.

outcomes.text: Your Scion stands the wall all night and blows a horn back at it. The calling stops for a week. Your Scion's hands shake for longer.
Your Scion stands the wall all night. In the morning they will not come down, and have to be carried, staring at the hills.

options.label: Leave it a recruit outside the walls.

outcomes.text: The calling stops at once. In the morning there is nothing outside the gate but a single neat footprint in the snow.

options.label: Shutters, and wax in every ear.

outcomes.text: Your Seat hears nothing. Your dogs are found in the morning standing at the gate, facing out, in a row.

together.text: Nobody answers. The calling goes on all winter, and the thing in the hills learns that the city is afraid of it.
